content.question: A model performs poorly on both the training and validation data. What does this indicate, and what is a good way to fix it?
options: Overfitting - apply stronger regularization and reduce features.
Underfitting - use a more complex model and add features that better represent the data.
Overfitting - collect more training data and stop training earlier.
Underfitting - increase the regularization strength and stop training earlier.
content.answer: Underfitting - use a more complex model and add features that better represent the data.
